entity: 2024 congressional races where outside spending beat the candidate's own; Moreno as the extreme case
what_we_add: The count: 104 of 637 races, 82 over $1M; and the 5.8x ratio ($152M vs $26M)
why: Inside Political Money and Newsweek both report Moreno relying on outside money that dwarfed his own ($186.1M vs $14.8M raised), same direction, within 25% of our outside figure. No source counts how many races flipped that way; 104 of 637 is ours alone.
